key_decisions: Input_Recipe, not Input_Style (Fabio): the node selects a prompt RECIPE, so the pattern - a bank of PrimitiveStringMultiline behind an MpiAnySwitch on an injectable MpiInt - is reusable by any later flow, and the name stays clear of Input_Style_Selector, which is the style-LoRA rack and a different thing.

Test rig is 1k + turbo ON, not 2k turbo-off (Fabio): placement is what these runs test, the sheet feeds another model, so quality proves nothing here and 2k costs time. Seeds are held between arms so a wording change is the only variable.

NAME THE HAIR ONCE, IN FULL (Fabio, 2026-08-19). Colour and texture together in the main hair clause; the rear clause names only how it falls or is tied, repeating no attribute. His reading: saying the same thing twice is the likelier source of the confusion. This REVERSES the proposed v4.1 amendment in prompts.md s2 (rear clause restates the colour), which stays as the record of what arm B measured but is unadopted. Noted honestly against it: arm B did measure better BY repeating, so the two readings predict different outcomes and the next arm separates them.

The template's global identity clause is a NO-OP (arm D, negative): Krea2 attends to concrete rear-view description and ignores a general 'all views must match' instruction. So the hair fix is enhancer-recipe payload; the sheet template stays exactly as Fabio wrote it and the graph does not move.
442 SaveImage is mode 4 (bypassed) in the hand-stripped graph, so only 494 Output_Image emits. Left alone - raw/ is user-owned and that is what the app contract wants anyway.
constraints: THE 'HAIR TEXTURE IS A V1 LIMITATION' CLAIM IS WITHDRAWN - do not act on it if an older note repeats it. Two defects were conflated: COLOUR was stated ('long iron-grey hair') and disobeyed on the rear panel, which is a real adherence failure; TEXTURE was never asked for at all, so a wavy back view violated no instruction and the actual defect is that the panels disagree with each other. Arm B put 'straight' in the REAR clause only while the main clause named no texture, so the mechanism was never tested.

comfy_workflows/raw/ is USER-OWNED. Every edit this card has made there was authorised by Fabio first; that is never standing permission. The arm D template change was applied to the API payload ONLY, deliberately, so a negative arm left no trace in his file.

THE GPU NOW NEEDS A LEASE (added 2026-08-19 by /mpi-project-refresh, commit 908343a0). A direct POST to 127.0.0.1:8188/prompt or :48188/prompt is blocked unless wrapped: python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/mpi-lib/scripts/gpu_lease.py" run -- <command>. It waits up to 1800s for the slot and polls every 15s, so run it as a BACKGROUND Bash call and waiting costs nothing. The lock is machine-global, one slot; `status` names the holder. Read-only probes (/queue, /history, /object_info, /view) are NOT matched - do not wrap those.

This card's event stamps before 2026-08-19T10:50Z are ~5-6h ahead of real time. NOT clock skew - Fabio confirms the VPN has been off for two days, and the machine clock agrees with GitHub's Date header at BST+1. They were authored by hand. Ground truth is `gh api rate_limit -i` -> the Date header.
